question: How do I update the app to the latest version?
answer: Open your phone's app store, search for the app, and select Update if a new version is available. You can also turn on automatic updates in the app store settings.

question: Why is the price in the app different from the website?
answer: Some offers are app-only or website-only, and prices can update at different times. The price shown at checkout is the one you pay.

question: How do I scan a barcode with the app?
answer: Open the scan option in the app, allow camera access, and point your camera at the product barcode to find the matching item.

question: Can I use the app with a weak or no internet connection?
answer: The app needs an internet connection to load products and place orders. If pages fail to load, switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data or try again when your signal improves.

question: How do I set up my new electronic product?
answer: Follow the quick-start guide in the box, which covers charging, powering on, and any companion app needed for setup. The full steps are also on the manufacturer's support page.

question: My new device will not turn on. What should I check?
answer: Charge it or connect it to power for a while, check the cable and socket, and try holding the power button for longer. If it still does not start, contact support with your order number.

question: How do I connect my device to Wi-Fi or Bluetooth?
answer: Turn on pairing or network setup mode as described in the manual, then select the device or network from your phone or the companion app. Keep the devices close together during setup.

question: How do I update my device's firmware or software?
answer: Check for updates in the device settings or the manufacturer's companion app, and keep the device charged and connected while the update installs.

question: My device is not charging. What should I do?
answer: Try a different compatible charger, cable, and power socket, and check the charging port for dust or damage. If it still does not charge, contact support or the manufacturer.

question: Where can I find the user manual for my product?
answer: The manual is usually included in the box or available as a download on the product page or the manufacturer's support website.

question: How do I reset my device to factory settings?
answer: Follow the reset steps in the user manual or the device settings menu. A factory reset erases your data and settings, so back up anything important first.

question: Where do I find the activation key for software I bought?
answer: Digital activation keys are usually shown in your order details and sent by email after purchase. Contact support if the key is missing or not accepted.

question: Where can I find the assembly instructions for my item?
answer: Assembly instructions are included in the package and are often available to download from the product page or the manufacturer's website.

question: Some screws or parts are missing from my assembly kit. What should I do?
answer: Check all bags and packaging layers against the parts list, then contact support with your order number and the part numbers that are missing.

question: How do I book an installation service?
answer: If installation is offered for the product, you can add it at checkout or book it later from your order details once the item is delivered.

question: Is there a charge for installation?
answer: Some products include free installation while others charge a fee. The cost, if any, is shown on the product page or when you book the service.

question: How do I reschedule my installation appointment?
answer: Open the installation booking in your order details to choose a new slot, or contact support if online rescheduling is not available.

question: Can you mount my TV or appliance on the wall?
answer: Wall-mounting services, when offered, are shown as an add-on for eligible products. Check that your wall type is suitable and whether a mounting bracket is included or must be purchased separately.

question: How are large appliances delivered and set up?
answer: Large appliances are usually delivered by a specialist team on a scheduled date. Make sure there is clear access to the installation spot, and check your order to see whether connection or setup is included.

question: How do I pre-order a product?
answer: If a product is available for pre-order, select Pre-order on the product page and complete checkout as usual. The expected release date is shown before you confirm.

question: When will I be charged for a pre-order?
answer: Payment timing for pre-orders is shown at checkout. Some pre-orders are charged when the item ships, while others are charged when the order is placed.

question: The release date of my pre-order has changed. What happens now?
answer: Your pre-order stays active and will ship when the item is released. You will be notified of the new date and can cancel if it no longer suits you.

question: How do I cancel a pre-order?
answer: Open the pre-order in your Orders section and select Cancel Order before it ships. If you were already charged, the refund follows the usual refund process.

question: Will I get a lower price if the pre-order price drops before release?
answer: Some pre-orders include a price guarantee that charges you the lowest price before release. Check the product page or pre-order terms to see whether it applies.

question: When will my pre-order be delivered?
answer: Pre-orders usually ship on or near the release date, and a tracking number is sent once the item is dispatched. Delivery time then depends on your address and delivery option.

question: How does Subscribe and Save auto-delivery work?
answer: Choose Subscribe and Save on an eligible product page and pick a delivery frequency. The item is then ordered and delivered automatically on that schedule, with no membership fee.

question: How do I change how often my auto-delivery arrives?
answer: Open Subscribe and Save in your account, select the subscription, and choose a new delivery frequency.

question: How do I skip an upcoming auto-delivery?
answer: Open Subscribe and Save in your account and select Skip for the next delivery before its order date. Your later deliveries continue as scheduled.

question: How do I cancel a Subscribe and Save auto-delivery?
answer: Open Subscribe and Save in your account, select the subscription, and choose Cancel. Deliveries already being processed may still arrive.

question: How much do I save with Subscribe and Save?
answer: Eligible subscription items receive a discount on each delivery. The exact discount is shown on the product page and may change with the item's price.

question: How do I change the items or quantity in my auto-delivery?
answer: Open Subscribe and Save in your account to change the quantity or remove an item, and add new items from eligible product pages.

question: Does the website work with screen readers?
answer: The website and app are designed to work with common screen readers and keyboard navigation. Contact support if any page is difficult to use with your assistive technology.

question: Can someone help me place an order if I have a disability?
answer: Contact customer support and explain the help you need. An agent can guide you through finding products and completing your order.

question: Can I get invoices or documents in an accessible format?
answer: Contact support to request documents such as invoices or policies in an accessible format, for example large print or a screen-reader-friendly file.

question: How can I contact support if I am deaf or hard of hearing?
answer: Use the email, chat, or text-based contact options in the Help section. If a relay service is supported, its details are listed on the Contact Us page.

question: How do I report an accessibility problem on the website or app?
answer: Contact support or use the feedback option and describe the page, the problem, and the device or assistive technology you were using.

question: Can I share my wishlist with friends or family?
answer: If wishlist sharing is supported, open your wishlist and use the Share option to send a link. You may also be able to make the list public or private.

question: Can I check out as a guest without creating an account?
answer: If guest checkout is offered, choose Continue as Guest at checkout and enter your contact and delivery details. Creating an account later makes it easier to manage orders and returns.

question: How do I change the country or region on my account?
answer: Look for the country or region setting in Account Settings or the website footer. Changing it may affect prices, available products, and delivery options.

question: How can I make the text larger or increase contrast on the website?
answer: Use your browser or device zoom, text-size, and high-contrast settings, which the website is designed to support. Contact support if a page does not display correctly with these settings.

question: Can the courier bring my parcel inside if I have limited mobility?
answer: Add a request in your delivery instructions or contact support before dispatch to ask about assisted delivery. Availability depends on the carrier and item size.

question: Do product videos have captions or transcripts?
answer: Many product videos include captions that you can turn on in the video player. Contact support if a video you need does not have captions or a transcript.

question: Can I sign in to the app with my fingerprint or face recognition?
answer: If biometric sign-in is supported, turn it on in the app's account or security settings after signing in once with your password. Your phone must also have fingerprint or face unlock set up.

question: Why does the app ask for access to my location?
answer: Location access can be used to show delivery options, nearby stores, or local prices. You can allow or deny it at any time in your phone's app permission settings.

question: Does the app have a dark mode?
answer: If dark mode is supported, turn it on in the app's display settings, or the app may follow your phone's system theme automatically.

question: Do I need to sign for my delivery or show ID?
answer: Some high-value or age-restricted items require a signature or ID check at delivery. Any requirement is usually shown in the order details or carrier notification.

question: How can I ask a question about a product before buying it?
answer: Use the questions and answers section on the product page, if available, or contact support with the product link and your question.

question: How do I report a fake or misleading review?
answer: Use the report or flag option next to the review, if available, or contact support with the product link and the review details.

question: Why can I not add an item to my cart?
answer: The item may be out of stock or unavailable in your region, or the page may not have loaded correctly. Refresh the page, check you are signed in, and try a different browser or the app.

question: Can I top up or reload my gift card?
answer: If reloading is supported, add funds from the wallet or gift card section of your account. Some gift cards have a fixed value and cannot be topped up.

question: Can I add a personal message to an e-gift card?
answer: Enter your message in the message field when you fill in the recipient details while buying the e-gift card. It is shown in the email the recipient receives.

question: Are there products I cannot buy with a gift card?
answer: Some items, such as other gift cards or certain memberships and subscriptions, may not be payable with a gift card. Any restrictions are listed in the gift card terms.

question: What should I prepare before the installation technician arrives?
answer: Clear the installation area, make sure the required power, water, or wall fittings are accessible, and keep the product and order details ready. Check the booking confirmation for any specific requirements.

question: How long does an installation appointment usually take?
answer: Duration depends on the product and the site. Simple installations may take under an hour, while complex appliances can take longer, and the booking confirmation usually gives an estimate.

question: Something was damaged during installation. What should I do?
answer: Take photos of the damage and contact support as soon as possible with your order and installation booking details so it can be investigated.

question: Can I pause my membership instead of cancelling it?
answer: If pausing is offered, the option appears in the Membership section of your account along with how long it can be paused. Otherwise, you can turn off auto-renewal and rejoin later.

question: Is there a student or discounted membership plan?
answer: Any student or reduced-price plans are listed on the Membership page with their eligibility requirements and how to verify your status.

question: Can I rejoin after cancelling my membership?
answer: Yes, you can usually sign up again from the Membership page at any time. Introductory offers or free trials may not be available to returning members.

question: Can I combine two separate orders into one shipment?
answer: Separate orders are usually processed and shipped independently and cannot be merged. Contact support quickly if both orders have not been packed yet.

question: I placed the same order twice by mistake. What should I do?
answer: Open the Orders section and cancel the duplicate order before it ships. If it has already shipped, you can return the extra items under the return policy.

question: Can I apply a coupon to an order I have already placed?
answer: Coupons usually need to be applied before the order is placed. Contact support to ask whether the discount can be honoured, or cancel and reorder if the order has not shipped.

question: Why is my order still showing as processing?
answer: Orders stay in processing while payment is confirmed and items are prepared for dispatch, which can take longer during busy periods. Contact support if the status has not changed by the expected dispatch date.

question: Which courier is delivering my order?
answer: The carrier name is shown in your shipping confirmation email and in the tracking section of your order details.

question: What does delivery exception mean in my tracking?
answer: It means something unexpected, such as bad weather, an address issue, or a missed connection, has interrupted the delivery. Check the carrier's details for the next step or contact support.

question: Can I save my card for faster checkout?
answer: If card saving is supported, select the option to save your card during checkout or add it in your account's payment settings. You can remove it at any time.

question: Can someone else pay for my order?
answer: Some checkouts let you share a payment link or use another person's card with their permission. Check the payment options at checkout, as the cardholder may need to complete bank verification.

question: Why is my order on hold for payment review?
answer: Some orders are briefly held for a security review to protect against fraud. You may be asked to verify details, and the order continues once the review is complete.

question: Where can I find care or washing instructions for a product?
answer: Care instructions are usually on the product page, the item's label, or the included documentation. Contact support if you cannot find them.

question: How do I know if a product is new, refurbished, or open-box?
answer: The product's condition is shown in the title, description, or condition field on the product page. Refurbished and open-box items may have different warranty and return terms.

question: How do I know if a product is suitable for a child's age?
answer: Check the recommended age range and safety information on the product page or packaging, and read any warnings before purchase.

question: Can I order other items together with a pre-order?
answer: You can usually place them in the same order, but in-stock items may ship separately or the whole order may wait until the pre-order item is released. Check the delivery details at checkout.

question: What happens if my card expires before my pre-order ships?
answer: Update your payment method in the order or your account's payment settings before the release date. If the charge fails, the pre-order may be cancelled.

question: Is my pre-order guaranteed if stock runs out?
answer: Pre-orders are usually fulfilled in the order they were placed, but allocations can be limited. You will be notified and refunded if your pre-order cannot be fulfilled.

question: Can I get a refund without returning the item?
answer: In some cases, such as low-value or damaged items, a refund may be issued without a return. Support will tell you if the item needs to be sent back.

question: How is my refund handled if I paid in instalments?
answer: Refunds for instalment purchases are usually sent to the card or provider used, which then adjusts your remaining instalments. Contact your bank or payment provider for how it affects your plan.

question: Can I get compensation if my delivery was very late?
answer: Compensation for late delivery depends on the store policy and the shipping option paid for. Contact support with your order number to check whether you are eligible.

question: Can I return an online order to a physical store?
answer: If in-store returns are supported, the option appears in the return workflow along with participating locations. Bring the item and your order details.

question: Can I return an item I bought from a third-party seller?
answer: Items sold by other sellers may follow that seller's return policy. Check the seller details and return information in your order before starting a return.

question: I sent back the wrong item by mistake. What should I do?
answer: Contact support as soon as possible with your return and order numbers and describe what was sent, so they can help locate the item.

question: Are there tiers or levels in the rewards programme?
answer: If the programme has tiers, your current level and what you need to reach the next one are shown in the Rewards section of your account.

question: How do I join the rewards programme?
answer: Sign in to your account and select Join on the Rewards page, if enrolment is required. Some stores enrol all account holders automatically.

question: Can I earn points for activities other than purchases?
answer: Some programmes award points for actions such as writing reviews or completing your profile. Eligible activities are listed on the Rewards page.

question: How do I turn off personalised ads and recommendations?
answer: Open your privacy settings to switch off personalised advertising or recommendations, and adjust optional cookies through the cookie settings.

question: I received an order confirmation for something I did not buy.
answer: Check your Orders section without using links in the email. If the order is there and you did not place it, change your password and contact support immediately.

question: How can I tell if a website or social media page is really yours?
answer: Only use the web address and app links listed on official channels, and be cautious of sites offering unrealistic discounts. Report any suspected fake site to support.

question: What happens if a subscription item is out of stock?
answer: If an item is unavailable on the order date, that delivery may be skipped or delayed and you will be notified. Your subscription remains active for future deliveries.

question: Will my Subscribe and Save price change over time?
answer: Prices and discounts can change between deliveries. The current price is shown in your subscription details and any reminder sent before each delivery.

question: How do I change the delivery address for my Subscribe and Save items?
answer: Open Subscribe and Save in your account, select the subscription, and update the delivery address before the next order date.

question: Can I get a copy of my chat with customer support?
answer: Some chat services let you email or download the transcript at the end of the conversation. Otherwise, ask the agent or check your support ticket history.

question: Can I contact customer support through social media?
answer: Official social media accounts, if available, are linked from the Help or Contact Us section. Never share passwords, card details, or verification codes in public posts.

question: Can I get help with a product I bought from another store?
answer: Support can usually help only with orders placed through this store. For other purchases, contact the original retailer or the manufacturer.

question: My device gets very hot. Is that normal?
answer: Devices can warm up while charging or under heavy use. If it becomes too hot to touch, unplug it, stop using it, and contact support or the manufacturer.

question: How do I transfer my data from my old device to a new one?
answer: Use the transfer or backup tool built into the device or the manufacturer's companion app, and follow its steps during setup. Back up your old device first.

question: The touchscreen or buttons on my device are not responding.
answer: Clean the screen, remove any case or screen protector, and restart the device. If it still does not respond, check the manual's troubleshooting steps or contact support.

question: I lost my receipt. Can I still make a warranty claim?
answer: Your order history or invoice in your account can usually serve as proof of purchase. Download the invoice from your order details and include it with your claim.

question: Does the warranty transfer if I give or sell the product to someone else?
answer: Some manufacturer warranties stay with the product, while others apply only to the original buyer. Check the warranty terms for transfer rules.

question: Who pays for shipping my product to a repair centre?
answer: For valid warranty claims, shipping costs are often covered by the seller or manufacturer. Check the repair instructions or contact support before sending the item.

question: Will I have to pay customs duties or import taxes on my international order?
answer: Orders shipped across borders may be subject to duties and import taxes set by the destination country. Any estimated charges are usually shown at checkout before you pay.

question: Are import charges included at checkout, or do I pay them on delivery?
answer: Some orders include duties and taxes in the checkout total, while others require the recipient to pay the carrier on arrival. Check the order summary to see which applies to your order.

question: My international parcel is held at customs. What should I do?
answer: Customs checks can add a few days to delivery. Follow any instructions from the carrier, such as providing details or paying charges, and contact support if the parcel stays held for a long time.

question: How do I return an item that was delivered to another country?
answer: Start the return from your order details to see the international return options available. Return shipping costs and any duties paid may be handled differently from domestic returns, so review the return instructions first.

question: Why can't certain items be shipped to my country?
answer: Some products cannot be exported to certain destinations because of local import rules, licensing, or seller restrictions. The product page or checkout will show if an item is unavailable for your country.

question: Which currency will I be charged in for an international order?
answer: The charge is made in the currency shown at checkout for your order. If your card uses a different currency, your bank converts the amount and may add its own fee.

question: How do I track a parcel that is being delivered internationally?
answer: Use the tracking link in your order details, which may switch to a local carrier once the parcel reaches your country. Updates can pause while the parcel is in transit between countries or at customs.

question: Do I need to provide any documents for customs clearance?
answer: In most cases the shipping paperwork is prepared for you. Some countries may ask the recipient for a tax or import identification number, and the carrier will contact you if anything else is needed.

question: When do your big sales usually happen?
answer: Major sale events are typically held around seasonal and holiday periods. Sign up for the newsletter or app notifications to hear about upcoming sale dates early.

question: The flash sale item sold out before I could buy it. Can I still get the deal?
answer: Flash deals usually have limited stock and end once it runs out, so the offer cannot normally be extended. Keep an eye on the deals page in case the item returns in a later sale.

question: Can I get the sale price on an order I placed before the sale started?
answer: Sale prices generally apply only to orders placed during the sale period. Check the store policies or contact support to see whether a price adjustment is possible for your order.

question: Can I combine more than one promotion on the same order?
answer: Whether offers can be combined depends on each promotion's terms. Usually only one discount code applies per order, and the checkout will show which promotions were accepted.

question: My free gift with purchase was not added to my order. What should I do?
answer: Check that your order met the offer conditions, such as a minimum spend or a qualifying product, and that the free item was in your cart before checkout. If it qualified but is missing, contact support with your order details.

question: What conditions usually apply to a promotion?
answer: Promotions often have conditions such as an end date, a minimum spend, eligible products, or a limit of one use per customer. The full conditions are listed in the details for each offer.

question: An item was listed at an obviously wrong price. Will my order be honoured?
answer: If a product was shown at a clearly incorrect price because of an error, the store may cancel or correct the order before it ships. You will be notified and refunded for any amount already charged.

question: Can I use a coupon on items that are already on sale?
answer: Some coupons exclude items that are already discounted. Check the coupon terms for excluded products, or apply it at checkout to see if the sale item qualifies.

question: How long will my parcel be held at the pickup point?
answer: Parcels are held for a limited period, often around a week, depending on the pickup location. The collection deadline is shown in your pickup notification and order details.

question: What do I need to bring to collect my parcel from a pickup point?
answer: You will usually need the pickup code or barcode from your notification and may be asked for photo ID. Check the pickup notification for the exact requirements.

question: My locker code is not working. What should I do?
answer: Check that you are at the correct locker and have entered the most recent code from your notification. If it still does not open, contact the locker provider using the help details on the locker or contact support.

question: The pickup point is closed. How can I collect my parcel?
answer: Check the location's opening hours in your pickup notification, as they may differ on weekends or holidays. If the location has closed permanently or for a long time, contact support to arrange another pickup point or delivery.

question: Can I change my pickup point after placing my order?
answer: You may be able to select a different pickup point from your order details before the parcel is shipped. Once it is on its way, changes depend on the carrier's redirect options.

question: My parcel was not collected in time and is being returned. Will I get a refund?
answer: Uncollected parcels are usually sent back to the seller once the holding period ends. A refund is typically issued after the return is received, and some shipping costs may not be refunded.

question: Where can I find my digital downloads after purchase?
answer: Digital purchases are usually available in the digital library or downloads section of your account, and a link may also be sent by email. Sign in to the same account you used to buy the item.

question: My download link has expired. How do I get a new one?
answer: Download links may expire after a set time for security. Open your digital library to generate a fresh link, or contact support if the item no longer appears.

question: Is there a limit on how many times I can download a digital purchase?
answer: Some digital products have a download or device limit set by the publisher. Any limit is shown on the product page or in your digital library.

question: Can I get a refund for a digital product?
answer: Digital items are often non-refundable once downloaded or accessed, though exceptions may apply for faulty or unusable content. Check the refund terms on the product page or contact support.

question: Which e-book formats are available and what devices can I read them on?
answer: The available formats, such as EPUB or PDF, and supported devices are listed on the product page. Some e-books can only be read in a specific reading app.

question: I cannot access my streaming or online content. What should I do?
answer: Make sure you are signed in to the account used for the purchase, check your internet connection, and try another browser or the latest app version. Contact support if access is still blocked.

question: Can I share my digital purchase with someone else?
answer: Most digital content is licensed for the buyer's personal use and cannot be transferred. Some products allow family sharing, which is described on the product page if available.

question: How do I download my digital purchases again on a new device?
answer: Sign in to your account on the new device and open your digital library to download your items again. Remove an old device first if you have reached a device limit.

question: How do I check whether a product I bought has been recalled?
answer: Visit the product recalls or safety notices page and search for your product's name or model number. Customers who bought an affected item are usually contacted directly as well.

question: What should I do if a product I own has been recalled?
answer: Stop using the product and follow the instructions in the recall notice. These usually explain how to get a refund, replacement, or repair.

question: Does this product meet safety standards or certifications?
answer: Safety marks and certifications are usually listed in the product specifications or on the packaging. Contact support if you need confirmation of a specific standard.

question: Where can I find the materials or allergen information for a product?
answer: Materials, ingredients, and allergen warnings are usually listed on the product page and the packaging label. Contact support if the information you need is not shown.

question: How do I report a product that seems unsafe?
answer: Stop using the product and contact support with your order details, a description of the problem, and photos if possible. Safety reports are reviewed as a priority.

question: Are there shipping restrictions for batteries or other hazardous items?
answer: Items with lithium batteries, aerosols, or flammable materials may need special shipping methods. They may take longer, be unavailable for express delivery, or be restricted for some addresses.

question: How do I send an order as a gift to someone at a different address?
answer: Enter the recipient's name and address as the delivery address at checkout and select the gift option if available. Tracking updates will still be sent to you.

question: Can I add a personal gift message to my order?
answer: If gift messages are supported, you can add one in the gift options at checkout. The message is usually printed on a card or the packing slip.

question: Can I hide the prices on the packing slip for a gift?
answer: Selecting the gift option at checkout usually removes prices from the packing slip. Check the gift options to confirm before you place the order.

question: How do I get a gift receipt for my order?
answer: A gift receipt can usually be requested in the gift options at checkout or printed from your order details. It shows the items without prices so the recipient can use it for exchanges.

question: Can I make sure a gift arrives in time for a birthday or special date?
answer: Check the estimated delivery date at checkout and choose a faster shipping option if needed. Some items allow you to pick a specific delivery date, which will be shown at checkout.

question: The person I sent a gift to wants a different size or colour. Can they exchange it?
answer: Exchanges for gifts are usually possible within the return window using the order details or gift receipt. The recipient can contact support with that information to arrange the exchange.
